title: Fibroblast-associated TPM2 links cell-matrix remodeling to EMT-Notch signaling and gemcitabine resistance in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
snippet: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICC) is an aggressive liver malignancy with heterogeneous responses to gemcitabine-based chemotherapy. The cellular and microenvironmental programs associated with the gemcitabine response remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to identify tumor microenvironment-associated regulators of gemcitabine response in ICC....
